in_marathi.name: मनीष
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: मनीष हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘ish’ meaning lord. Derived from the Rigveda, it symbolizes the intellect, knowledge, and wisdom that one can attain by connecting with their inner self and the universe.

in_bengali.name: मनीष
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: मनीष একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। From the Sanskrit word ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘ish’ meaning lord. Derived from the Rigveda, it symbolizes the intellect, knowledge, and wisdom that one can attain by connecting with their inner self and the universe.
